headline: Turkey Forecasts $78 Billion Investment for Development Road Corridor
summary: Turkey projects its portion of the Development Road, a planned transit corridor connecting Iraq to Europe, will generate over $78 billion in commercial investment.
why: Transport corridors linking the Persian Gulf to European trade routes alter regional freight dynamics and infrastructure investment distribution.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Major logistics infrastructure developments stimulate investment across construction and transport sectors.
